bullets.text: The meteorological department issued heavy rain alerts for Chennai, Thiruvallur, and Chengalpattu, prompting the office to monitor weather developments closely.
Heavy rains lashed multiple areas across Chennai on Monday morning, and the office should track waterlogging and traffic impacts.
Gummidipoondi recorded severe air pollution surpassing Delhi levels, and the district team should watch for environmental intervention measures.
Poonamallee vehicle owners faced threats after questioning RTO checkpoint extortion, and the office must monitor police action on this corruption complaint.
Pattabiram residents requested the Highways Department to build a roundabout on CTH Road, and the office should support local infrastructure follow-ups.
An editorial highlighted artificial intelligence posing existential challenges to human identity, and the portfolio team should note ongoing discussions on machine intelligence.
